{{Quote|Be careful! There's a whole squad of Sith troopers on the other side of that door! You need to find some way to thin their numbers.|Carth Onasi, warning Revan|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Gender" /> '''Sith commander''' and<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> [[Sith trooper (Sith Empire)|heavy trooper]] was part of the group sent to board the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Hammerhead-class cruiser|''Hammerhead''-class cruiser]] ''[[Endar Spire]]'' during the [[Jedi Civil War]] between the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] and the Galactic Republic. During the [[Attack on the Endar Spire|attack]] on the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] [[Orbit/Legends|above]] the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]<ref name="KOTOR" /> in [[3956 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] led a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] on the starboard side of the vessel near the [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] bay. [[Amnesia/Legends|Amnesiac]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], with the memories of a [[Republic soldier]] and the assistance of Republic war hero [[Carth Onasi]], [[Death/Legends|killed]] the commander and their squad during<ref name="KOTOR" /> his<ref name="Campaign">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> escape from the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]], shortly after which it was destroyed.<ref name="KOTOR" />

The commander was a heavy Sith [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] and wore the [[Color/Legends|red]] variant of [[Sith trooper armor/Legends|Sith trooper armor]]. They were proficient with and wielded a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]], a [[Droid/Legends|droid]]-damaging [[Ion blaster/Legends|Ion blaster]] [[Pistol/Legends|pistol]], and an [[Prototype vibroblade|upgradeable prototype]] [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]]. The Sith was trained in the use of with heavier [[Armor/Legends|armor]] types, [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]], and personal [[heavy weapon]]s.<ref name="KOTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|You could reprogram the damaged assault droid to help you, if you have enough repair parts. Or you could use computer spikes to slice into the terminal and use the ''Endar Spire's'' security systems against the Sith|Carth Onasi, to Revan|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
The Sith commander first appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', developed by [[BioWare]]. They appear in a mandatory encounter within a room aboard the ''Endar Spire''. Carth Onasi will contact Revan and advise them to defeat the commander's squad by either repairing a nearby [[sentinel droid]] or using a [[computer terminal]] to overload the room's [[Power conduit/Legends|power conduit]], killing all the soldiers in the process. The player cannot access the room until one of these options are used, though repairing the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] allows the player to enter the room and engage in direct combat with the commander. The player may not progress the story until the soldiers have been killed.<ref name="KOTOR" />
